The `python` job failed on the basedpyright per-rule gate: in `_parse_tool_call_delta` a `Final` local was reassigned (reportGeneralTypeIssues +1) and the new `.get` chains on the untyped chunk added two reportUnknownMemberType errors. Pushed a typing-only follow-up (casts, no behavior change): with the same environment, every rule count for the file is now at or below the merge-base (162 → 155 errors; the +1/+2 are gone). `ruff check`/`ruff format --check` and the 22 cohere unit tests pass. `codecov/patch` (one uncovered line) is unchanged. Pushed as a new commit on the branch, no force-push.

Drafted with the assistance of an AI agent (Claude) working for the author.

Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Medium impact]** The PR appears safe to merge, with no actionable issues found

Summary

Fixes Cohere v2 streamed tool calls by reading `tool-call-start` and `tool-call-delta` from `delta.message.tool_calls` - Cohere v2 chat streams now send complete, separate tool calls. `pcbeingused333` acknowledges that `message-end` remains unread and is tracked separately, null `arguments` can fail but have not been seen live, and Responses API rejection of `strict` and zero initial usage are unchanged Reviews (1) · Last reviewed commit: ["fix(cohere): close a streamed tool call ..."](https://github.com/berriai/litellm/commit/54a9233b652be79db07a7e1c374f2d261e442c39) · [Reviewed by Greptile](https://www.greptile.com/?utm_source=greptile_review&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=review_public&utm_content=berriai/litellm)
